title: abab is deprecated
summary: npm directs users of abab to the platform-native atob and btoa functions.

constraints: Preserve accepted input, binary-string output, thrown errors, Unicode handling, and support for the project's minimum runtime.

steps.title: Use platform Base64 functions
steps.instructions: Replace abab imports and calls with the runtime's native atob and btoa functions, then remove the dependency.

verification.purpose: Run Base64 edge-case and repository tests.
